content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| summarize DAU=dcount(UserId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Daily Active Copilot Users

content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| summarize WAU=dcount(UserId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 7d)
| render timechart
content.title: Weekly Active Copilot Users

content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| where isnotempty(AppHost)
| summarize Users=dcount(UserId), Interactions=count() by AppHost
| order by Interactions desc
| render piechart
content.title: Adoption by App

content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| summarize FirstUse=min(TimeGenerated) by UserId
| summarize NewUsers=count() by bin(FirstUse, 1d)
| order by FirstUse asc
| extend CumulativeUsers=row_cumsum(NewUsers)
| render timechart
content.title: Cumulative Unique Users

content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| summarize Interactions=count() by UserId
| top 25 by Interactions desc
| render barchart
content.title: Top 25 Power Users

content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| summarize Interactions=count() by UserId
| summarize Users=count() by Bucket=case(
    Interactions <= 5, "1-5",
    Interactions <= 20, "6-20",
    Interactions <= 50, "21-50",
    Interactions <= 100, "51-100",
    "100+")
| render barchart
content.title: Engagement Distribution

content.query:
CopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Workload == "Copilot"
| extend Hour=hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| summarize Interactions=count() by Hour
| order by Hour asc
| render columnchart
content.title: Activity by Hour
